results.title: Ulterior Motives: The Story Behind the Song
results.original_title: Ulterior Motives: The Story Behind the Song
results.overview: Explore the incredible and bizarre journey of the infamous lost song "Ulterior Motives". From its 1980s origins to becoming a viral mystery that stumped thousands of internet sleuths for years and millions of streaming fans.

results.title: Bad Voodoo
results.overview: Two escaped convicts break into a house and take a hostage, only to discover that the hideout houses something far more dangerous: a voodoo curse born from a grieving couple’s thirst for vengeance. As the night spirals into terror, they must battle an unseen power that feeds on guilt, blood, and lost souls.

results.title: TN 2026
results.overview: Set in Pollachi, the story follows a powerful landlord, Sivalingam Mandradiyar, who becomes obsessed with a rising actor, Kukanth Kumar, believing he is the next M.G.R. He pours his wealth into shaping the actor's career and political future. But as ambition and fame grow, so does the risk of downfall. Will it lead to power or ruin?

results.title: Reflections
results.overview: While rebuilding a vintage car with his young daughter, Jack begins experiencing unsettling distortions within the familiar walls of his garage. As reality quietly unravels around him, an emotional portrait of family and connection emerges.

results.title: Mother, What Would I Do Without You?
results.overview: Confronted with the devastating reality of her mother’s terminal diagnosis, a young woman embarks on a compressed emotional journey to fulfill her mother's final, unexpressed desires before her imminent decease, forcing a profound reckoning with grief and filial duty.

results.title: The Artists
results.overview: In a cold warehouse, two criminals debate their careers future over the rise of AI.

results.title: 1936 : El Año que se Perdió el Miedo al Poder
results.original_title: 1936 : El Año que se Perdió el Miedo al Poder
results.overview: The feature-length documentary on the historic year of 1936 in Venezuela: the first year of Eleazar López Contreras's government, following the death of Juan Vicente Gómez and 27 years of dictatorship. A film that shows, like never before, a portrait of the Venezuelan people and of a changing society. 90 years later, this documentary—an unprecedented historical audiovisual record—recreates an image of the past that is unique in its kind for Venezuelan historiography.

results.title: Cookie Queens
results.overview: A celebration of girlhood and the complexities that come with it, Cookie Queens is a coming-of-age story about the joys, pressures, and tensions woven into one of America’s most cherished rituals: Girl Scout Cookie season.

results.title: Take a Piece of Me With You for the Rest of Your Life
results.original_title: Leve um Pedaço de Mim Para o Resto de sua Vida
results.overview: Cornélia is on her way to meet her wife, Carmem, at a restaurant that holds special memories for both of them. As the meeting unfolds, small cracks appear in their conversation and silences, revealing hidden layers of their relationship and leaving the impression that not everything is quite as it seems.

results.title: Breast Friends Forever
results.overview: Beauty-and-breasts besties Astrid Lee and Audrey Avila team up with sharp-tongued detective and comedy legend Janno Gibbs to solve the hilarious case of men getting way too… well, inflated.

results.title: Terri Joe: Missionary in Miami
results.overview: In this wild farce, Southern Belle Terri Joe ventures to Miami to outrun wacky criminals and find a new church where she can atone for her sins.

results.title: Amore mio – Niemand ist wie Du
results.original_title: Amore mio – Niemand ist wie Du

results.title: Avec Kim
results.overview: After a typical day at the garage, a young mechanic swaps her stained overalls for a leather ensemble—as she shifts gears into a different kind of routine. Driving through bustling Paris, she helps a passerby cross the street, delivers plants to a hardware store, and picks up an enigmatic passenger.

results.title: Ten Reasons to Die After You
results.original_title: As Dez Vantagens de Morrer Depois de Você
results.overview: Devastated by the tragic death of her best friend, Gabriela discovers that she left behind an unexpected parting gift: ten letters containing challenges designed to help her overcome her grief.
